mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with positive month-over-month PAYEMS change, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5% and remains above this level for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that compresses equity valuation multiples, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months meeting FEDFUNDS trigger condition, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates tightening monetary policy amid labor market strength, increasing recession risk and depressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening policy with strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC for interaction signal over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-employment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a further decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market tightness that may trigger wage inflation and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with UNRATE decline in high-employment regime, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,200,000 units per month (1200.0 in thousands), it signals strong consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with HOUST > 1200.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with positive month-over-month RSAFS change, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals manufacturing slowdown coupled with reduced housing demand, causing supply-demand mismatch that depresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO rises and HOUST falls, or Rank IC for interaction signal over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production regime (INDPRO > 115.0), a further increase in industrial output (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with INDPRO > 115.0 and positive month-over-month INDPRO change, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.
